The '''G-5 Geltab''' was a basic [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] geltab produced by [[Genetech Laboratories]], which was used in most [[medkit]]s to provide easy access to a small amount of bacta. The geltab could be placed on a wound to speed up healing.
